Package org.rcmd.jneuroformats

Class Nifti1Header

java.lang.Object
org.rcmd.jneuroformats.Nifti1Header
public class Nifti1Header extends Object
Models the header of a NIfTI-1 volume file (the single-file .nii variant). The header is exactly 348 bytes long and contains, among others, the volume dimensions, the voxel data type, the voxel sizes (pixdim), and the spatial transform from voxel to world coordinates, given either as an affine transform (sform) or as a quaternion (qform). Only standard-compliant NIfTI-1 files are supported. The FreeSurfer "hack" of storing surface data in NIfTI files (using dim[1] as a signed vertex count) is not supported.
